# ADR-0055 - Rotate credentials quarterly

## Decision

Credentials rotate every 90 days.
statement: Directory location is conventional, never normative; kind MUST NOT be inferred from it.
note: The SAME ADR record text is parsed from three different directories, including `docs/decisions/` (the conventional home of `decision`-kind records). The kind MUST be 'adr' in all three, because kind comes from the H1 and nothing else.
